title: Kaizen project config
description: Schema for the per-repo .kaizen.toml seeded by `/kaizen:setup install`. Drives the kaizen pre-commit gate (compile barrier, architecture log, plan dir, backlog, optional verify_cmd) and points to the brain + project-memory directories. Generated by setup.sh — hand-editable. Validated by Taplo via the project-root taplo.toml or the `#:schema` directive at the top of the file.

compile_check_cmd.description: Command kaizen runs as the project's compile barrier (e.g. `cargo check --workspace --offline`, `npx --no-install tsc --noEmit`, `ruff check .`). Auto-detected at setup; override here to pin a specific invocation.

architecture_log.description: Path (repo-relative) to the append-only architecture-decision log. Default `.kaizen/workflow/progress.md`. Touched by the pre-commit gate when a commit logs structural changes.

plan_dir.description: Directory (repo-relative) where multi-phase plans live. Default `plans`. `/kaizen:create-plan` writes `<plan_dir>/<date>-<slug>.md` here.

backlog_path.description: Path (repo-relative) to the rendered backlog markdown. Default `.kaizen/workflow/backlog.md`. NEVER hand-edit this — it's regenerated from `.kaizen/workflow/backlog.json` by `/kaizen:backlog`.

verify_cmd.description: Optional secondary verification command run by the gate AFTER the compile barrier passes (e.g. fast unit tests). Empty string = skip.

allow_deletion_env.description: Name of the env var that, when set to `1`, bypasses the pre-deletion belief gate for a single commit. Default `KAIZEN_ALLOW_DELETE`. Override only when this var name collides with project tooling.

skip_tdd_check_env.description: Name of the env var that, when set to `1`, lets a commit land without the TDD pairing check. Default `KAIZEN_SKIP_TDD_CHECK`.

brain_path.description: Absolute path to the kaizen Second Brain. Default `~/.claude/.kaizen/brain`; can be overridden via the `KAIZEN_BRAIN_DIR` env var. Used by `/kaizen:brain` flows and the pre-deletion belief scanner.

project_memory_path.description: Absolute path to the per-project auto-memory directory (`~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory`). Used by the memory-analyst subagent and the pre-commit memory check.
